instructions: task.controls.method is the function. context contains its runtime data
task.controls.parameters are references to values in context
task.controls.expression is to be calculated, using values from task.controls.parameters. return is the outcome of the calculation
task.controls.spec defines the reasoning applied to return. task.controls.result is the outcome of that reasoning.
In task.controls.expression, minus is arithmetic subtraction. The numeric value on the right is subtracted from the numeric value on the left. Both values come from task.controls.parameters.

controls.spec: The calculated value of return is the accepted outcome
